description.text: It is available all year round. The applicant should study for at least 10 academic hours per week. Please register at least 1 month before you intend to begin one-on-one classes. The tuition during the regular academic semester is: 80 RMB/academic hours. Other Fees to Pay Item Fee Registration Fee 100 USD Room (per person per day ) simple standard room 2.5 USD standard room 5 USD Meal (USD per person per day; or at the students own choice at student cafeteria) 5-8 USD Textbooks and Materials Pay the actual cost Tours Pay the actual cost

duration.text: The One-to-One Class on Academic Semester at Sichuan University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 11 USD/per hour ￥ 80 CNY/per hour

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Under 60 years old 2.Senior middle school education or higher
